findings.title: JSON data HTML-escaped in script tag breaks JSON.parse()
findings.description: {{overallJson}} and {{subEventResultsJson}} use double-brace Handlebars syntax, which HTML-escapes &, <, >, and ". Any contestant or event name containing these characters produces malformed JSON inside the <script type="application/json"> tag. JSON.parse() throws, the catch block hides the breakdown table and shows the empty-state message instead.
findings.correction: Change both to triple-brace unescaped output: {{{overallJson}}} and {{{subEventResultsJson}}}.

findings.title: Overall Results button missing for tabulator role
findings.description: The task requires the button in isAdmin, isOrganizer, and isTabulator sections. show.xian has no {{#if isTabulator}} block in the action toolbar at all (confirmed by grep). The commit message also omits isTabulator. Tabulators can access the route but see no UI entry point.
findings.correction: Add a {{#if isTabulator}} toolbar section containing the Results button and, inside {{#if event.isEventSeries}}, the Overall Results button, matching the pattern used for isAdmin and isOrganizer.
